mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates continued monetary easing.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.0% signals labor market weakness and potential economic contraction, causing immediate negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to deteriorating economic conditions.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth slows.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between HOUST and RSAFS (measured by the product term) has a Rank IC less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), rising interest rates compress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in higher discount rates.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A declining industrial production (INDPRO < 90.0) indicates weakening economic activity and reduced corporate output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 3.0% signals central bank tightening, causing immediate negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher interest rates.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth prospects weaken.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between PAYEMS and UNRATE (measured by the product term) has a Rank IC less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 3.0%), the S&P 500 underperforms due to profit-taking and anticipation of monetary tightening, leading to negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when GDPC1 QoQ growth > 3.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.
